summary: The compaction hook for all three hosts, wired by init as Claude PreCompact, Codex PostCompact and Cursor preCompact (unwire strips all three). It reads the hook stdin, keys on session_id (falling back to Cursor's conversation_id) and calls resetSeen from recall-seen.mjs so notes shown or written before the compaction become re-injectable, logging 'compaction (<event>, trigger=...) ... cleared N seen ids' to .coldstart/kb-hook.log. It prints nothing and always exits 0. Codex is wired on PostCompact rather than PreCompact because Codex PreCompact defers the compaction on a non-zero exit. Cursor has no post-compaction hook, and clearing in preCompact is safe because the next prompt always lands after the compaction. Verified end to end with a real claude -p session: inject, then dedup silence, then /compact fired PreCompact and cleared 1 id, then inject again.
